---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a scoped capability or improvement
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the user or operational problem, not only the proposed implementation.

## Proposed outcome

State observable acceptance criteria.

## Architecture impact

Which tools, agents, schemas, graph state/topology, API adapters, or
infrastructure boundaries would change? Explain how dependency direction and
deterministic calculation ownership remain intact.

## Security and privacy

Describe authentication, authorization, secret, prompt, audit, data-retention,
and telemetry implications.

## Alternatives

What other approaches or existing capabilities were considered?

## Operational impact

Describe SLO, scaling, deployment, rollback, observability, and recovery needs.

## Additional context

Add sanitized examples or diagrams. Do not include credentials or customer
data.
